product.name: PractiCode Learn
product.headline: Learn by doing. Not by watching.

parent.name: PractiCode Academy
parent.relationship: PractiCode Academy is the first delivery partner and runs the Mentor plan (cohorts, online and in Ibadan).

colorRules: Practi Yellow is a fill colour only. Never yellow text, and never thin yellow lines on light backgrounds.
Text on yellow is always Code Black or Ink.
Yellow never carries meaning alone on light backgrounds (fails WCAG 1.4.11 at 1.3:1 against Paper). On light surfaces, progress and state use Ink; on dark surfaces, yellow is fine (13.9:1).

code.note: Functional exception to Poppins-only: code must be monospaced.

typography.case: Title Case for labels and buttons, sentence case for sentences. No all-caps except acronyms.

logo.status: Interim redraws from the documented geometry. Replace with files from PractiCode_Academy_Official_Logo_Pack.zip.
